title: MULTISCALE COMP SCI ＆ ENGIN
description: Introduction to multiscale analysis. Information-passing bridging techniques: among them, generalized mathematical homogenization theory, the heterogeneous multiscale method, variational multiscale method, the discontinuous Galerkin method and the kinetic Monte Carlo–based methods. Concurrent multiscale techniques: domain bridging, local enrichment, and multigrid-based concurrent multiscale methods. Analysis of multiscale systems
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ENME E4332 ) and ENME E4332 ; Elementary computer programming, linear algebra.
